label: Уйти
description: A 10-sentence conjugation card for уйти (to leave, to go away).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: First-person perfective future. 'Уйду' is the 1sg future of perfective уйти, built with prefix у- on the future stem уйд-. The prefix у- marks departure away from a place.

Strategic focus: Second-person future. 'Уйдёшь' is the 2sg future of уйти, end-stressed on the ё, which must be typed exactly. The imperfective partner уходить describes leaving regularly or in progress.

missions.phrase: Он уйдёт с работы в шесть.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Third-person future. 'Уйдёт' is the 3sg future of уйти. 'С работы' uses с + genitive to mark moving away from work. The prefix у- frames a complete exit.
Strategic focus: First-person plural future. 'Уйдём' is the 1pl future of уйти, end-stressed. The clause 'как только' sets the departure right after the action completes.
Strategic focus: Polite/plural future. 'Уйдёте' is the 2pl future of уйти, contrasted here with staying. The ё stays stressed across this future stem.
Strategic focus: Third-person plural future. 'Уйдут' is the 3pl future, completing the future scaffold of уйти. Note the future stem уйд- across all six persons.

missions.phrase: Он ушёл, не сказав ни слова.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Suppletive masculine past. 'Ушёл' is prefix у- on the suppletive past root ш-, with no и and no д. It is the masculine past of уйти and reports a completed departure.

missions.phrase: Она ушла на работу рано утром.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Suppletive feminine past. 'Ушла' uses the irregular ш- past root with the prefix у-, marking a female subject. Past tense tracks gender, not person.
Strategic focus: Suppletive plural past. 'Ушли' is the plural past of уйти on the suppletive ш- root, sharing nothing with the future stem уйд-. This closes the past series.
Strategic focus: Singular imperative. 'Уйди' is the sharp informal command from уйти, telling someone to leave at once. The imperfective partner уходить would soften it into a habitual frame.
